items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was the guy. He was the head of the jazz department. Very – George Butler was very easy to work with, very helpful, very well dressed, very well mannered. George was a nice guy.

ctx.x: Columbia, I guess, that would have been the George Butler era? No . . . .
Yeah, yeah. I was there when George Butler was there.
